packageRules.description: policy: Skip routine patch updates for language packages; keep minor, major, runtime, app, and security updates
Group identical packages across all files

Keep golang Dockerfile updates disabled because annotated ARGs manage Go image tags separately from Go toolchain versions, and the Dockerfile manager also expands ARG-backed FROM images; source: https://github.com/spigell/my-images/pull/383; review after: 2026-12-07

Keep the Pulumi CLI, workbench image and core SDKs (Go, npm, Python) on the manually approved version 3.267.0, already merged in pulumi-talos-cluster; source: https://github.com/spigell/pulumi-talos-cluster/pull/63; review after: 2026-11-02

my-cloud-resume runs TypeScript through ts-node, which has no TypeScript 7 compiler API; the repositories that already moved to TypeScript 7 keep getting its updates / my-cloud-identity lints with typescript-eslint, which supports only TypeScript below 6.1 and crashes on TypeScript 7 / my-reforge-ai lints with typescript-eslint 8.71.0, which rejects TypeScript 7.0 until upstream adds support / my-cloud-infra runs Pulumi through ts-node/esm, and ts-node 10.9.2 crashes on TypeScript 7 (no sys API) / my-blockchain-infra runs Pulumi programs and bots through ts-node/esm, and ts-node 10.9.2 crashes on TypeScript 7 (no compiler API) / my-reforge-tasks lints Pulumi with typescript-eslint, which supports only TypeScript below 6.1 and crashes on TypeScript 7; source: https://github.com/spigell/my-cloud-resume/pull/58, https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/pull/12803, https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/issues/10940, https://github.com/TypeStrong/ts-node/issues/2174, https://github.com/spigell/my-blockchain-infra/pull/12, https://github.com/spigell/my-reforge-tasks/pull/140; review after: 2026-11-06
